choose.when: AND o.refund_order_id IS NOT NULL AND o.refunded_amount = 0
AND o.refund_order_id IS NOT NULL AND o.refunded_amount > 0 AND o.pay_amount > 0 AND o.refunded_amount >= o.pay_amount
AND o.refund_order_id IS NOT NULL AND o.refunded_amount > 0 AND o.pay_amount > 0 AND o.refunded_amount < o.pay_amount
AND o.refund_order_id IS NULL AND o.refund_application_status = 'PENDING_MERCHANT'
AND o.refund_order_id IS NULL AND (o.refund_application_status IS NULL OR o.refund_application_status <> 'PENDING_MERCHANT') AND o.aftersale_status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING','WAITING_SUPPLEMENT')
choose.otherwise: AND o.refund_order_id IS NULL AND (o.refund_application_status IS NULL OR o.refund_application_status <> 'PENDING_MERCHANT') AND (o.aftersale_status IS NULL OR o.aftersale_status NOT IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING','WAITING_SUPPLEMENT')) AND o.order_stage = #{displayStatus}

mapper.sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.merchant_id, o.store_id, o.service_id, o.order_stage, o.payment_status, o.verification_status, o.refund_application_status, o.aftersale_status, o.refund_order_id, o.original_amount, o.discount_amount, o.pay_amount, o.refunded_amount, o.appointment_start_at, o.appointment_end_at, o.paid_at, o.confirmed_at, o.verified_at, o.canceled_at, o.created_at, o.reschedule_count, o.version, s.service_name, s.category_name, s.merchant_name, s.store_name, s.store_address, s.service_price, s.service_duration_minutes FROM pet_order o LEFT JOIN order_service_snapshot s ON s.order_id = o.id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pet_order o LEFT JOIN order_service_snapshot s ON s.order_id = o.id WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT id, order_id, dimension, from_status, to_status, event_type, operator_type, operator_id, remark, created_at FROM order_status_log WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
